jobs.title: Principal Lead- Product Owner
jobs.description:
About Our Company

Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.

Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

Job Description

The Enterprise Architecture Product Owner is responsible for managing and evolving the Enterprise Architecture operating model, products, governance processes, work management practices, and knowledge repositories. The role serves as the central coordination point for architecture planning, execution tracking, governance, process maturity, documentation standards, reporting, and continuous improvement. This role requires close collaboration with Enterprise Architects and Technology Leaders to improve adoption of architecture standards, governance processes, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps

The individual drives consistent adoption of architecture processes maintains operational discipline across architecture teams, and drives transparency through effective governance, metrics, Jira management, and executive reporting.

The ideal candidate combines strong product ownership, program management, and Agile delivery expertise with a solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture practices and governance. They are highly organized, process-driven, and experienced in Jira and Confluence administration, Scrum and Kanban methodologies, backlog management, story-point estimation, executive reporting, and documentation governance. The individual will drive operational excellence, process maturity, transparency, and adoption across the Enterprise Architecture function.

Key Responsibilities
- Own the roadmap, backlog, adoption strategy, and operational metrics for Enterprise Architecture products, services, and governance capabilities.
- Define, document, govern, and continuously improve Enterprise Architecture processes, standards, workflows, templates, and operating procedures.
- Serve as the owner of the Enterprise Architecture operating model, ensuring consistent execution of architecture governance, planning, review, and lifecycle management processes.
- Manage architecture work intake, prioritization, planning, capacity management, and execution tracking across the Enterprise Architecture team.
- Act as the Jira and Confluence subject matter expert, administering workflows, automations, dashboards, reporting, templates, and knowledge repositories.
- Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices, including backlog management, story creation, story-point estimation, sprint planning, Kanban flow management, and milestone tracking.
- Establish and maintain architecture documentation standards, architecture artifacts, governance records, and knowledge repositories to ensure information is accurate, current, and accessible.
- Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and reports that provide visibility into architecture demand, priorities, capacity, risks, dependencies, progress, and business outcomes.
- Facilitate architecture governance forums, architecture reviews, planning sessions, retrospectives, and cross-functional working sessions.
- Drive accountability for maintaining accurate work items, status updates, milestones, architecture artifacts, and governance records within Jira and Confluence.
- Establish and track KPIs, maturity metrics, adoption measures, and performance indicators to assess the effectiveness of Enterprise Architecture services and governance practices.
- Prepare executive presentations, leadership communications, governance updates, status reports, and decision-support materials.
- Identify and implement process improvements, automation opportunities, and AI-enabled capabilities that enhance architecture planning, governance, reporting, documentation, and operational efficiency.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- 12+ years of overall experience in technology program management, Agile delivery, PMO, delivery management, or related discipline.
- Demonstrated experience as a Program Manager, Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, or similar role within a technology organization.
- Strong practical experience with Jira administration, including workflow configuration, automation, dashboards, filters, and reporting.
- Experience coordinating work across multiple teams and driving accountability without direct reporting authority.
- Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder-management, and follow-up skills.
- Experience preparing executive dashboards, leadership presentations, status reporting, and decision-support materials.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain attention to detail, and operate effectively with senior leaders and architects.
- Broad understanding of enterprise technology domains, including cloud, networking, security, data, platform engineering, and AI, with the ability to collaborate effectively with architects across these areas.

Preferred Qualifications
- Working knowledge of AWS cloud concepts and services.
- Familiarity with Enterprise Architecture practices, governance processes, and technology portfolio management.
- Experience with Confluence, Power BI, Jira and similar collaboration and reporting tools.
- Understanding of AI productivity tools and their practical application to workflow automation, reporting, and knowledge management.
- Experience establishing governance routines and operating processes for technology teams.
- Agile, Scrum, Jira, project management, or program management certification.

In-Office Collaboratio n
We are a client-centric, relationship-based business. Working together, in-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face-to-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Job Description

Serves as the Product Owner for Salesforce CRM capabilities, with primary responsibility for Experienced Advisor Recruiting (EAR) and support for additional business lines across the CRM platform. Partners with business line leaders and Technology teams to define, prioritize, and deliver enhancements across Salesforce and related platform integrations. Responsible for translating business needs into requirements and user stories, driving execution through the development lifecycle, and developing and managing a product roadmap. Acts as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, ensuring technology solutions improve business outcomes and user experience.

Key Responsibilities

Major areas of accountability:
User Requirements ~~ Product Road Map ~~ Stakeholder Engagement ~~ Subject Matter Expertise ~~ Execution / Implementation Leadership ~~ User Acceptance Testing ~~ Product Support & Performance Management

- Coordinate the prioritization and delivery of CRM enhancements supporting EAR as the primary business partner while contributing across the broader CRM platform. Partner with business and technology stakeholders to translate business needs into requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, maintain a prioritized product backlog, and guide delivery of solutions that improve business outcomes and user experience. Participate in Agile delivery activities and make prioritization decisions regarding scope, risks, dependencies, and implementation impacts.
- Lead roadmap planning, solution design, and delivery activities for CRM capabilities supporting EAR and other business partners. Evaluate enhancement requests, business opportunities, and platform capabilities, provide subject matter expertise on business requirements and solution options, and partner with cross-functional teams to deliver enhancements aligned with business and platform priorities.
- Gather and analyze feedback from business users, support cases, and production issues to identify opportunities for platform enhancements and process improvements. Monitor adoptionand user satisfaction to assess solution performance and inform prioritization decisions. Support user acceptance testing, validate requirements, and recommend improvements that enhance business outcomes and user experience. Coordinate resolution of production issues, including impact assessment, prioritization, stakeholder communication, and validation of fixes.
- Develop and maintain effective partnerships with business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and end users to support the successful delivery and adoption of Field Leader CRM capabilities. Coordinate communication, release readiness, and change management activities to ensure solutions are understood, adopted, and delivered with minimal business disruption.

Required Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in product management, product ownership, business analysis, or a related technology role.
- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience in Business, Computer Science or related field.
- Experience supporting Salesforce Sales Cloud solutions, including requirements management, backlog prioritization, testing, and release delivery.
- Proven success delivering technology enhancements that improve business processes, user experience, and measurable business outcomes.
- Demonstrated ability to translate complex business needs into requirements, user stories, and actionable delivery plans.
- Experience working in Agile environments, including backlog management, sprint planning, backlog refinement, user acceptance testing, and release activities.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to evaluate risks, dependencies, tradeoffs, and implementation impacts.
- Demonstrated ability to build effective partnerships with business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and cross-functional delivery teams.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence decisions and communicate effectively across all levels of the organization.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting financial advisor growth, sales, recruiting, or related business processes.
- Experience within the financial services industry.
- Experience serving as a Product Owner within an Agile delivery model.
- Experience supporting Salesforce integrations, data management, security, reporting, or platform governance activities.

Base Pay Salary

The estimated base salary for this role is $105,000 - $130,000 / year. We have a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy. Your initial total compensation may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographical work location. In addition, most of our roles are eligible for variable pay in the form of bonus, commissions, and/or long-term incentives depending on the role. jobs.title: Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) Data Product Owner
jobs.description:
About Our Company

We’re a diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. Job Description

The AEP Data Product Owner will lead the ownership, evolution, and day-to-day stewardship of the Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) ecosystem for Ameriprise, ensuring our customer data foundation powers Real-Time CDP, Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), and Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) capabilities across the enterprise.

At Ameriprise, we are focused on personalizing the customer experience to acquire, deepen, and retain lifelong relationships by helping customers build financial confidence and achieve their life goals. The AEP Data Product Owner will play a critical role in enabling that vision by ensuring our customer data is trusted, well-governed, and activated to power personalized journeys, end-to-end measurement, and next-generation marketing experiences. It's not about the data itself, but the customer experiences that data can enable.

Key Responsibilities:
Real-Time CDP Enablement
- Lead the data enablement of Real-Time CDP use cases — profile orchestration, audience creation, and real-time activation — to power personalized customer journeys.

- Ensure high-fidelity behavioral and profile data is captured and mapped correctly into AEP to fuel next-generation marketing strategies across AJO, CJA, and downstream destinations.

- Own a future-proof data product roadmap for AEP that prioritizes scalability, personalization at scale, and rapid deployment of new customer experience capabilities.

Data Integrity & Platform Health
- Define and maintain the standard for AEP data assets — XDM schemas, identity namespaces, and profile merge policies — to keep data clean, trusted, and usable.

- Monitor dataflow health; proactively identify and resolve data issues before they impact marketing performance.

- Manage the lifecycle, including feature adoption, data quality standards, and governance in partnership with Technology, Privacy and Legal.

Strategic Data Liaison
- Act as the primary data point of contact for Adobe — influencing product roadmap and ensuring Ameriprise's data needs are prioritized.

- Partner with Technology, Marketing, and Analytics teams on customer data strategy, identity resolution, and use case enablement.

- Develop data KPIs to track data quality, ingestion latency, profile health, license consumption, and the efficiency of audience activation.

License Usage & Consumption Management
- Monitor AEP license consumption across profiles, data volume, compute, etc, proactively identify overage risks and lead remediation strategies.

- Own data retention, TTL, and ingestion optimization decisions that keep the platform within contracted license thresholds without compromising business use cases.

- Provide usage insights and forecasts to leadership to inform investment decisions, true-ups, etc.

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in business administration, computer science, information systems, data science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- 5 or more years of relevant experience in marketing technology, data product management, or customer data platform operations.

- 2 or more years of hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Platform / Real-Time CDP, including working knowledge of XDM schemas, Identity Service and Profile Service.

- Proven experience owning a data product backlog and roadmap in an Agile environment.

- Strong understanding of data ingestion (batch and streaming), data quality management, and identity resolution strategy.

- Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver data-driven capabilities.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex data concepts for executive audiences.

Preferred Skills:
- Adobe Certified Expert — Real-Time CDP Business Practitioner or Adobe Experience Platform credentials.

- Hands-on experience with Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) and/or Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO).

- Familiarity with SQL, data profiling, and data quality tools; experience with Dataiku or similar platforms.

- Experience with data & analytics transformation (current-state assessment, strategy development, value case, roadmap).

- Business translation skills — identifying business problems, translating them into use cases and data/mar-tech capabilities, and storytelling for leadership audiences.

Our unwavering focus on our clients and strong financial foundation connects each of our unique businesses – Ameriprise Financial, Columbia Threadneedle Investments and RiverSource Insurance and Annuities. Job Description

At Ameriprise Financial, we're committed to helping early-career talent build meaningful careers through hands-on experience, professional development, and mentorship. Our 10-week summer internship program gives you the opportunity to contribute to business-critical initiatives, connect with leaders across the organization, and gain insight into a FORTUNE 500® financial services company.

Guided by our values of excellence and respect for individuals and communities, you’ll engage with senior leaders through opportunities such as the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) Speaker Series and participate in volunteer programs that support the communities where we live and work.

The Digital Experience & Marketing team creates innovative digital products and experiences that strengthen the client-advisor relationship and help clients achieve their financial goals. As a Digital Product Owner Intern, you'll work alongside product, design, analytics and technology teams to help shape digital experiences that deliver value for clients and advisors.

Throughout the summer, you'll develop foundational skills in product strategy, customer experience, analytics, Agile delivery, and stakeholder collaboration while contributing to real business outcomes.

About the Role
As a Digital Product Owner Intern, you'll contribute to the development and enhancement of digital experiences that support clients and advisors. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you’ll gain practical experience across key areas of digital product management including:
- Digital Product Strategy and Execution

- Consumer-Facing Web and Mobile Experiences

- Digital Analytics and Performance Measurement

- User Experience (UX) Research and Design

- Agile Product Development and Delivery

Examples of Past Intern Projects
- Conducted user testing and analyzed feedback to inform product enhancements for a new digital trading platform

- Evaluated portfolio experience concepts for the Secure Client Site to improve usability and client engagement
- Researched virtual meeting experiences across competitors to identify industry trends, best practices, and opportunities for innovation

Required Qualifications
- Current Junior at a 4-year university pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Business Administration/Management, Project Management, Entrepreneurial Management, Marketing, or related field
- Graduation date of December 2027 or May/June 2028

Preferred Qualifications
- High degree of self-motivation with strong integrity and ethics
- Proven organization skills and ability to manage time effectively
- Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills
- Ability to work and communicate collaboratively and constructively with others
- Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite
- A passion for and strong interest in engaging digital experiences, including consumer-facing websites and mobile apps

Visa Sponsorship
Applicants must have a valid work authorization that does not now, or in the future, require visa sponsorship for employment in the United States (e.g., H-1B, F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, TN).

In-Office Collaboration
We are a client-centric, relationship-based business. Working together, in-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face-to-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least four (4) days per week, with flexibility to work from home one (1) day per week. Some roles may require additional in-office time or different in-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.

Base Pay Salary

The estimated base salary for this role is $29/hourly. We have a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy. Your initial total compensation may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographical work location. In addition, most of our roles are eligible for variable pay in the form of bonus, commissions, and/or long-term incentives depending on the role.
